command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

WV=$(whatshap --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $1}')

echo "== phase: whatshap reads haplotype linkage off reads that span MORE THAN ONE variant =="
whatshap phase -o phased.vcf --reference ref.fa variants.vcf sample.bam > phase.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 phase.log; exit 1; }
grep -E 'reads covering|cover at least two|Largest block' phase.log
COVER=$(sed -n 's/.*Kept \([0-9]*\) reads that cover at least two variants.*/\1/p' phase.log)
test -n "$COVER" && test "$COVER" -gt 0 || { echo "no read spans two variants -- phasing is impossible, not merely poor"; exit 1; }

echo "== one block, all six variants, one phase set =="
grep -v '^#' phased.vcf | awk '{print $2, $10}'
NV=$(awk '!/^#/{n++} END{print n+0}' phased.vcf)
NPH=$(awk '!/^#/ && $10 ~ /\|/ {n++} END{print n+0}' phased.vcf)
NPS=$(awk '!/^#/{split($10,a,":"); if(a[2]!="")print a[2]}' phased.vcf | sort -u | awk 'END{print NR+0}')
test "$NV"  = "6" || { echo "expected 6 records, got $NV"; exit 1; }
test "$NPH" = "6" || { echo "only $NPH of 6 variants were phased"; exit 1; }
test "$NPS" = "1" || { echo "$NPS phase sets -- the variants did not link into one block"; exit 1; }

echo "== score against the PLANTED phase using whatshap's own comparison =="
whatshap compare --names truth,whatshap truth.vcf phased.vcf > cmp.txt 2>&1
grep -E 'switch errors:|switch/flip decomposition:|Block-wise Hamming distance:|Different genotypes:' cmp.txt | head -4
SW=$(awk '/switch errors:/{print $NF; exit}' cmp.txt)
HD=$(awk '/Block-wise Hamming distance:/{print $NF; exit}' cmp.txt)
DG=$(awk '/Different genotypes:/{print $NF; exit}' cmp.txt)
test "$SW" = "0" || { echo "$SW switch errors against the planted haplotypes"; exit 1; }
test "$HD" = "0" || { echo "Hamming distance $HD against the planted haplotypes"; exit 1; }
test "$DG" = "0" || { echo "$DG genotypes disagree with the fixture"; exit 1; }

echo "== phase is defined only UP TO A GLOBAL FLIP -- so flip it and score again =="
awk 'BEGIN{FS=OFS="\t"} /^#/{print;next}
  { if($10 ~ /^1\|0/) sub(/^1\|0/,"0|1",$10); else if($10 ~ /^0\|1/) sub(/^0\|1/,"1|0",$10); print }' \
  phased.vcf > flipped.vcf
whatshap compare --names truth,flipped truth.vcf flipped.vcf > cmpflip.txt 2>&1
SWF=$(awk '/switch errors:/{print $NF; exit}' cmpflip.txt)
HDF=$(awk '/Block-wise Hamming distance:/{print $NF; exit}' cmpflip.txt)
test "$SWF" = "0" || { echo "flipped phasing scored $SWF switch errors -- the metric is NOT flip-invariant"; exit 1; }
test "$HDF" = "0" || { echo "flipped phasing scored Hamming $HDF -- the metric is NOT flip-invariant"; exit 1; }
# and the naive comparison, for contrast: it calls the flipped (correct) phasing wrong everywhere
NAIVE_OK=$(awk '!/^#/{split($10,a,":"); print $2"\t"a[1]}' phased.vcf  | sort > /tmp/a.txt
           awk '!/^#/{split($10,a,":"); print $2"\t"a[1]}' truth.vcf   | sort > /tmp/t.txt
           comm -12 /tmp/a.txt /tmp/t.txt | awk 'END{print NR+0}')
NAIVE_FLIP=$(awk '!/^#/{split($10,a,":"); print $2"\t"a[1]}' flipped.vcf | sort > /tmp/f.txt
           comm -12 /tmp/f.txt /tmp/t.txt | awk 'END{print NR+0}')

{
printf 'Phasing -- haplotypes assigned from reads, scored against haplotypes we built\n'
printf 'whatshap_version\t%s\n' "$WV"
printf 'reads_spanning_2plus\t%s   (assert >0 -- a read covering ONE variant carries no phase information at all)\n' "$COVER"
printf 'variants_phased\t%s of %s   (assert all)\n' "$NPH" "$NV"
printf 'phase_sets\t%s   (assert 1 -- all six linked into a single block)\n' "$NPS"
printf 'switch_errors\t%s   (assert 0 -- vs the PLANTED haplotypes)\n' "$SW"
printf 'hamming_distance\t%s   (assert 0)\n' "$HD"
printf 'different_genotypes\t%s   (assert 0)\n' "$DG"
printf 'flipped_switch_errors\t%s   (assert 0 -- the COMPLEMENT of a correct phasing is equally correct)\n' "$SWF"
printf 'naive_gt_match_as_emitted\t%s of 6\n' "$NAIVE_OK"
printf 'naive_gt_match_flipped\t%s of 6   (a raw GT diff calls the flipped -- correct -- phasing wrong everywhere)\n' "$NAIVE_FLIP"
printf 'note\thaplotype LABELS are arbitrary: which block is 1| and which is |0 carries no meaning.\n'
printf 'note\tThat is why the score is switch errors between adjacent pairs, not equality of GT strings.\n'
} | tee smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
